# MyLifeElsewhere

> > Interactive comparison platform for visualizing geographic sizes, cost of living, income levels, tax rates, and quality of life metrics across countries and cities worldwide.

MyLifeElsewhere provides data-driven comparison tools helping users understand relative differences between countries like the United States, China, Russia, Egypt, Canada, and others. The platform features interactive map visualizations for geographic size comparisons and comprehensive statistical comparisons for relocation planning and international research.

## Key Topics

- Country comparison
- Geographic size visualization
- Cost of living analysis
- City comparison
- Tax rates comparison
- Income comparison
- Quality of life metrics
- International statistics
- Relocation planning
- Map visualization tools
- Country perimeter analysis
- Relative size comparison
- United States
- China
- Russia

## Core Comparison Tools

- [MyLifeElsewhere.com: Worldwide Country and City Comparison](https://www.mylifeelsewhere.com/): Homepage for worldwide country & city comparison tool
- [Country Size Comparison](https://www.mylifeelsewhere.com/country-size-comparison): Interactive map tool comparing geographic sizes of two countries
- [City Size Comparison](https://www.mylifeelsewhere.com/city-size-comparison): Interactive map tool comparing geographic sizes of cities worldwide

## Country Comparison Hubs

- [Compare Egypt to](https://www.mylifeelsewhere.com/compare/egypt): Egypt comparison hub for income, taxes, and cost of living metrics
- [Compare Aruba to](https://www.mylifeelsewhere.com/compare/aruba): Aruba comparison hub for income, taxes, and cost of living metrics

## Geographic Size Comparisons

- [Size of United States compared to Iran](https://www.mylifeelsewhere.com/country-size-comparison/united-states/iran): United States vs Iran geographic size and population comparison
